purpose: Replicate the B/C/D/R Highway top-k experiment as a separate Spark hardware stratum, explicitly authorized after the M6 plan was frozen.

hardware.placement: Any available DGX Spark selected by JY; record the selected node, then freeze that node for matched build/correctness and timing blocks.
hardware.reason: User explicitly allows any Spark. Let JY select eligible available capacity with the exact cached model. Never interrupt another job.
hardware.memory: Record actual physical/unified memory in the probe; do not substitute marketing capacity for observed bytes

C.name: Current qualified upstream-backed sampler, Linux/CUDA build

D.name: Same-source Highway top-k candidate, Linux/CUDA build
D.source: Freeze after profile prerequisite and implementation, before build admission

R.name: Candidate with optimized top-k disabled, Linux/CUDA build
R.role: Diagnostic only; never a replacement comparator or normalization factor

build.policy: Compile all Spark arms with the same admitted Linux compiler, optimization and CUDA architecture flags. No cross-OS binary reuse. Record compiler/tool versions and source/native-object/executable hashes. Preserve B's native source; platform harness adapters are separately identified and identical across Spark arms.
build.selection: The experiment changes CPU top-k only; CUDA decoding/backend sampling behavior is unchanged. Record actual selected Highway target; source support alone does not prove NEON executed.
build.probe: Check cache/hash readability, compiler/CMake/Ninja/CUDA tools, profiler permissions, CPU features, GPU compute capability, thermal/throttling telemetry and model-free process state before build. No model generation in the probe.
build.backend: GGML_CUDA=ON, GGML_METAL=OFF, GGML_ACCELERATE=OFF; architecture/toolchain flags frozen from observed probe evidence before candidate build. Native sampler perf counters disabled in all arms.

inputs.semantic_corpus: The same five frozen synthetic grammar cases, prompt/template/tokenizer/continuation controls, sampler settings and seeds as plan.json.
inputs.logits: Capture once using frozen B on CUDA, freeze ordered fixture/logit hashes before correctness and timing, and replay exactly those bytes in every Spark arm. Hardware-native capture is separate from M6 input identities; no cross-hardware pooling or absolute-speed attribution.
inputs.matched_decode: Teacher-forced native CUDA decode using identical sequences per arm. Correctness checks precede timing. Supplemental unconstrained cases remain separate from the five-case grammar aggregate.

statistics.unit: Fresh independent four-worker Spark block; only one model resident at a time. Loading and prescribed warmup excluded from timing.
statistics.confidence: Same one-sided 95% paired block-bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 7301, case-balanced geometric mean ratios as plan.json
statistics.qualification_partition: Three predetermined ten-block jobs, all 30 audited together; no optional stopping or block/case removal.

gates.correctness: Same native, public-ABI, seeded, MTP-recovery and new differential top-k tests as plan.json; freshly pass on Spark before timing
gates.sampler_no_regression: Every primary case and aggregate D/C and D/B upper one-sided 95% bound <=1.01
gates.decode_no_regression: Every primary case and aggregate D/C and D/B decode-throughput lower one-sided 95% bound >=0.99
gates.telemetry: Record available Linux CPU and NVIDIA thermal/throttle observations. Unknown telemetry is explicitly unknown, never mapped to healthy; resolve required thermal/co-tenancy instrumentation before admitting timing. Retain observed invalid jobs; no exclusions or normalization.
gates.portability_claim: Report each hardware stratum independently. A claim that the optimization benefits both requires every applicable gate to pass in both strata. A Spark pass cannot rescue an M6 failure, or vice versa.

execution.dependencies: Probe audit and shared MLflow readback -> frozen build configuration -> build and correctness -> five-block screen -> thirty-block qualification -> independent audit/readback.
execution.recording: Dedicated Spark parent and flat B/C/D/R rows carrying hardware/backend/source/precision fields. Empty metrics stay blank. Filter Spark and M6 dashboards separately; never combine results.
execution.unchanged: M6 admitted jobs, original sampler PR/results and every existing gate remain unchanged. No application deployment/restart, KV changes, new agents, Slack, or unrelated plugin investigation.
